title: Center a captive crossbar before docking its carrier
instruction: Centre the orange sliding crossbar within the blue carrier. Push the intact carrier into the grey dock until its body and crossbar are fully inside; the rear handle stays outside. Release it and move both hands clear.
context: A protruding captive transport element can stop an otherwise complete assembly from entering a handling fixture. This unpowered tabletop analogue tests correcting the assembly envelope and proving clearance by docking the intact assembly.
setup: Fixed layout; lengths metres, masses kg. YAM bases (0,+/-.305,.750), facing +x; oak-appearance table 1.10 x 1.30 x .060, top z=.7475. Free blue carrier mass .250, root (.280,0,.7555), identity rotation: Body .180 x .140 x .016; RearStem .040 x .024 x .016 at (-.110,0,0); HandlePost .024 x .024 x .048 at (-.120,0,.024); Handle .024 x .024 x .032 at (-.120,0,.056); guide cheeks .008 x .140 x .024 at (+/-.018,0,.020). Orange link mass .040, passive y-slide initially q=+.050, limits +/-.055, origin (0,q,.022) relative to carrier: Bar .020 x .140 x .016 and Grip .020 x .024 x .028 at local (0,0,.024). Grey dock fixed at (.4825,0,.7900): side walls .205 x .010 x .085 at local y=+/-.080; back .010 x .170 x .085 at local x=.1075; four .012 x .170 x .010 roof strips at world x=.386,.420,.495,.579, roof centre z=.8275. Inner volume x=.380..585, y=+/-.075, z=.7475..8225; table supplies floor. White centre/edge/depth cues are noncolliding. Printed-polymer-like rigid surrogates; friction is an uncalibrated simulation assumption. Full centres, cue dimensions and joint properties are in README and contract.py.
scoring: Current terminal outcome, not historical maximum. All nonzero grades require |q|<=.004 m, tilt<=5 degrees, lowest body corner within .004 m of tabletop, both link linear speeds<=.010 m/s and angular speeds<=.100 rad/s, slide speed<=.010 m/s (reported and pose-derived speeds). .25: those conditions alone. .50: additionally body world-x extent midpoint>=.380; every payload corner |y|<=.0755, z=.7470..8230, x<=.5855; whole rear Handle x<=.3805; any assembly corner at x>=.3795 obeys those y/z/back limits. Payload=Body, both guide cheeks, entire Bar and Grip. 1.0: additionally every payload corner x>=.3795; both grippers>=.80 open and both TCPs>=.080 m from all assembly solids including rear handle, continuously 1.00 s with sample gaps<=.075 s. Otherwise .50/.25/0 as applicable. Permanent 0 for malformed/nonfinite data, invalid quaternion/gripper range, nonincreasing time/step, incorrect initial layout, moved dock (> .002 m or 2 degrees), q outside +/-.0555, crossbar linkage mismatch (> .002 m or 2 degrees from carrier transform of (0,q,.022)), or any assembly corner below z=.7275. Initial step0/t0 requires root within .003 m of start, rotation within 2 degrees and q within .003 m of +.050. README specifies exact validity/temporal rules.
run_limit: 1600 control steps (80 seconds simulated time at 20 Hz), seed 0, fixed layout, zero object jitter; terminate at first completed 1.0 goal by default.
reset_notes: No consumables. Reset open robot arms/action buffers, free root to (.280,0,.7555), identity rotation, slide to +.050 and object velocities to zero; clear scorer/hold/controller/trace state and settle. Repeated reset purges prior contacts using .20 m temporary staging clearance and .10 s free dynamics before fresh placement, only before the first scored observation. Runtime logs and verifies measured settled reset; fixed dock stays in place.
fidelity: Rigid box compounds and ideal passive captive prismatic joint; zero stiffness, damping/friction and finite limits, no latch or episode pose writes. Guide cheeks omit real captive-guide internals. Printed-polymer-like materials uncalibrated. PGS64/16; roof windows expose bar. RGB640x360 resized320x176 at20Hz; demo has privileged poses, Dream does not. Fixed-layout simulation feasibility only; physical rebuild and precise camera-only control unproven.
scores: Dream-1 run: 0.0 (1600 steps); demo: 1.0 (799 steps); two consecutive reset-validation trials: 1.0 each.
